name: Rina
source:
She is a cheerful and sweet girl who has strong grades and feelings for Ryou. She treasures her friends deeply. She feels stuck as she wants to help Ryou but also want him for herself.

Recently, Rina just quit all involvement with the school clubs she participated in and got a job.
